in_sanskrit.name: Havisa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Havi's giver
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Havisa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Havi', meaning 'oblation' or 'offering'. The suffix 'sa' indicates the giver or the one who offers. In Hindu mythology, Havi is the name of a goddess who represents the divine offering or the giver of offerings.
